content: पुष्कल {%a.%} [पुष्-कलच् किच्च; पुष्कसिध्मा˚लच् वा <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 Much, copious, abundant; भक्षितेनापि भवता नाहारो मम पुष्कलः <ls>H. 1. 81</ls>; प्रजां प्राप्नोति पुष्कलाम् <ls>Ms. 3. 277</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 63</ls>. .²2 Full, complete; स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः <ls>Bg. 11. 21</ls>; आविरासीद्यथा प्राच्यां दिशीन्दुरिव पुष्कलः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 3. 8</ls>. .²3 Rich, magnificent, splendid. .²4 Excellent, best, eminent. .²5 Near. .²6 Loud, resonant, resounding. .{@-लः@} .²1 A kind of drum. .²2 An epithet of Śiva. .²3 Of mount Meru. .{@-लम्@} .²1 A particular measure of capacity = 64 handfuls. .²2 Alms to the extent of four morsels of food.
